$description: Closed assetRole enum. Wired through schema/pagespec.schema.json (per-field enums), tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json assetRoles and the example/fixtures. Asset fields are {assetRole} objects only - never file paths (rule NO_ASSET_URLS).

generationValues.must-reuse-exact: Use the existing asset/component exactly, for its existing job; do not generate a replacement.
generationValues.may-generate-new: New instances may be composed within the guidance and forbidden list.
generationValues.must-not-fabricate: Render a neutral placeholder only; never generate, trace or source imagery for this role.

realCompanyPolicy.appliesTo: Every generated PageSpec, copy string and asset decision made from this design-repo.
realCompanyPolicy.context: The clone reproduces the layout of rig.ai, a real, live company's marketing site. The clone's COPY is original placeholder text written for the clone (src/content.js, src/blog.js, src/legal.js) - but it still uses the real company name 'Rig' / 'Rig AI Inc.', and the clone ships the real wordmark, logo mark and some original SVG artwork as build evidence.
forbiddenToReproduce: The Rig name as a mark: wordmark (public/assets/rig-wordmark.svg), logo mark SVGs (hero/footer watermark, CTA logo/glow/line-art), favicon, RIG ASCII art
rig.ai's original marketing, blog, waitlist or legal copy (reference/original-site/*.html) - enforced by ORIGINAL_COPY_FINGERPRINT
The original site's text labels baked into intro-diagram.svg / surveillance-eye.svg, when used as copy
Real people's names/photos, real customer logos, testimonials
The original's backend endpoints, Turnstile site key, PostHog keys
The commercially licensed Chalet font file in production (see fontPolicy)
enforcement: asset fields accept only the closed assetRole enum; brand.* / text.ascii-brand-art / placeholder.* are must-not-fabricate
NO_ASSET_URLS rejects file paths/URLs in content
NO_EXTERNAL_TARGETS + NO_BACKEND_ENDPOINTS block outbound links and submission endpoints
realCompanyPolicy.publication: Private design-review artifact (status design-review-pending, productionApproved false). Do not publish it or present it as Rig's design system.

Chalet.guidance: Chalet London Nineteen Sixty (House Industries) is a commercially licensed font. The clone's copy is build evidence only; a production build must license it or substitute a licensed display face. Generators reference {font.family.display}, never the file.

Geist Pixel Square.license: believed open (Geist family, SIL OFL) - confirm

roles.description: Logo slot in the header (60x22) and footer (18px). The clone ships the REAL Rig wordmark (public/assets/rig-wordmark.svg).
roles.guidance: Render a neutral placeholder mark of the same box size (or the client's own logo supplied by a human). Never reuse, trace, recolour or approximate the Rig wordmark.
forbidden: the word 'Rig' set as a logotype
roles.licensing: Real company trademark (rig.ai). Build evidence only; not licensed for generated output.

roles.description: The Rig logo mark used decoratively: hero watermark, footer watermark, CTA logo + bloom glow, CTA oversized line-art, favicon.
roles.guidance: Leave the slot empty or use a neutral geometric placeholder at the same size/opacity. Never reproduce the Rig mark (hero-watermark.svg, footer-watermark.svg, cta-logo*.svg, cta-oversized-lineart.svg, favicon data URI).
roles.licensing: Real company trademark. Build evidence only.

roles.description: Block-letter 'RIG' ASCII art in the terminal boot session (copied from the original markup).
roles.guidance: Render a neutral block-letter placeholder (or the client's name). Never the RIG letters.
forbidden: ASCII renderings of any real brand

roles.description: The closed set of 11 16x16 pixel-art badge icons (badgeIcons keys).
roles.guidance: Pick one of the 11 iconKey values; never draw a new pixel icon.
roles.licensing: Extracted from the original site's inline SVG markup - review before any production use.

roles.description: UI glyphs: FAQ chevron, copy/check, spinner, success check, error alert, feature check, back arrow, CTA return arrow.
roles.guidance: Reuse the existing glyph for its existing job only.
roles.licensing: Mostly extracted from the original markup; generic shapes.

roles.description: X and LinkedIn logos inside the dashboard share buttons.
roles.guidance: Only inside the share buttons, unmodified, per the networks' brand rules. Never as decoration.

roles.description: 480-viewBox surveillance eye (pupil tracking + blink) in the problem section.
roles.guidance: Reuse as-is in problem.signal-grid only. Its small text labels are the ORIGINAL site's wording (see findings) - replace them with new copy before production.
roles.licensing: Extracted from the original site; contains original label text.

roles.guidance: Reuse as-is; labels may only be string-replaced with new copy (src/svg/README.md). Never generate a new diagram that implies real product architecture.
roles.licensing: Extracted from the original site; contains the original's text labels (incl. 'RIG').

roles.description: Red dashed connector + X glyph between offline flow cards.
Red wireframe vortex raster behind the CTA (webp + png fallback, 2106x1307).
roles.guidance: Reuse only in cta.vortex, anchored bottom, width 105vw. Do not generate substitute photography.
forbidden: AI-generated replacement art presented as the original
roles.licensing: Downloaded from the original site - licence unknown; replace before production.

roles.description: Blog post diagram slot. The original image returns 502 at origin; the clone renders a neutral placeholder box (16:9 / 3:4 <=768 / 4:3 <=400).
roles.guidance: Always render the neutral placeholder box with the alt text; never generate or source a diagram image.

roles.description: SVG filter defs: #grainy feTurbulence (overlays) and #bloom (CTA logo).
roles.guidance: Reuse the existing filter definitions; do not add new filters.

roles.description: WebGL dither canvas (src/lib/ditherShader.js - GLSL written for the clone). Instantiated only through the closed preset enum.
roles.guidance: Use preset 'headline' (intro, early access) or 'how' (how-it-works) exactly; no custom uniforms from a PageSpec.

roles.description: The How overlay card's ASCII bar charts, rendered from data (label, fill 0-20, value, highlight) with █ ░ ▎ glyphs.
roles.guidance: New charts may be composed from the typed blocks (caption / bars / lines) within maxWords. Values are illustrative copy, not measurements - never present them as real benchmarks.
forbidden: claims presented as real benchmark data
